cases.name: President Trump Says Adam Schiff Should Be Arrested For Treason

sentences.1: President Trump has suggested Rep. Adam Schiff (D-CA) should face 'arrest for treason' after he 'illegally made up a FAKE & terrible statement' that he read out in Congress in an attempt to frame the president.
sentences.2: For the second time in days, President Trump has accused a Democratic member of Congress of treason, escalating his attacks on those leading an impeachment inquiry against him based on a complaint lodged by a 'whistleblower' with no first-hand knowledge of events.
sentences.3: On Sunday, Trump tweeted that Schiff should be 'questioned at the highest level' for 'treason.'
sentences.4: Trump suggested in a tweet Monday that House Intelligence Committee Chair Adam Schiff (D-CA) should face 'arrest for treason,' claiming Schiff 'illegally made up a FAKE & terrible statement.'
sentences.5: President Trump was referring to Schiff's 'analysis' of Trump's July 25 call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
sentences.6: Schiff misrepresented the call as a gangster-like shakedown, with Trump blatantly threatening the Ukrainian president.
sentences.7: The U.S. Constitution defines treason as waging war on the U.S. or giving 'aid and comfort' to American enemies.
sentences.8: Punishment for the crime may include the death penalty.
sentences.9: During a House hearing Thursday, Schiff tried to ramp up criticism of President Trump portraying him as a mob boss.
sentences.10: 'It reads like a classic organized crime shakedown,' Schiff said of Trump's call.
sentences.11: 'Shorn of its rambling character and in not so many words, this is the essence of what the president communicates.'
sentences.12: He then parodied Trump's call in wildly inaccurate terms.
sentences.13: 'We've been very good to your country, very good.
sentences.14: No other country has done as much as we have, but you know what?
sentences.15: I don't see much reciprocity here,' Schiff said, supposedly 'parodying' Trump's demands to the Ukrainian leader.
sentences.16: 'I have a favor I want from you, though, and I'm gonna say this only seven times, so you better listen good.
sentences.17: I want you to make up dirt on my political opponent, understand, lots of it.'
sentences.18: Schiff explained he was trying to make clear what the president 'was trying to communicate with the president of Ukraine.'
sentences.19: 'This is, in some character, what the president was trying to communicate with the president of Ukraine,' Schiff said.
sentences.20: 'It would be funny if it wasn't such a graphic betrayal of the president's oath of office.'

Explanation.explanation: Describing Schiff's portrayal of Trump as a 'mob boss' and a 'gangster-like shakedown,' invokes strong emotional reactions rather than addressing the specifics of the call.
Schiff's exaggerated parody of Trump's call creates a distorted version of the argument, making it easier to attack.
The claim that Schiff should be arrested for treason is a strong conclusion that is not sufficiently supported by the evidence provided.
